{{Quote|As it turns out, Soobu's swooper friends were part of a bigger gang. Ever heard of the Desert Banshees?|[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]|<ref name="SWG:LV" />}}
The '''Desert Banshees''' were a [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] of [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]] present on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were wiped out by the [[Valarian Syndicate]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==History==
{{Quote|They aren't members of Jabba's regular gangs. I believe the Hutt is "evaluating" the Banshees to see if they are worthy of joining his organization.|[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]|<ref name="SWG:LV" />}}
The Desert Banshees were led by the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Kilth Saanu]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Banshees proposed to join [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal organization]]. The swoopers were thus assigned to various missions under the supervision of [[Arrud Barsoomu]], Jabba's right hand enforcer in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], so the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] could evaluate whether they were worthy of joining his organization.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Desert Banshees were tasked with escorting the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealer [[Soobu Javeedo]] while conducting his business in the territory of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate]] and main rival of Jabba. Javeedo and two swoopers were soon ambushed and killed by Valarian henchman. Lady Valarian therefore discovered the ambition of the Banshees to join Jabba's organization and decided to eliminate them before. A group of spacers loyal to Valarian then attacked Kilth Saanu and four of his thugs near Mos Eisley and killed them all in the ensuring firefight. After the death of their leader, the rest of the Desert Banshees scattered.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Desert Banshees appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]'' [[Star Wars Galaxies]], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Desert Banshees were present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:LV" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and the Desert Banshees were consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
